nodes.description: msg.sender, the external caller; attacker-controlled and used for every admin/authorisation check.
block.timestamp exposed as `now`, used for signature expiry validation.
Administrator address of the market/comptroller; guards all privileged functions.
Pending administrator address awaiting acceptance.
Comptroller contract that polices mint/redeem/borrow/liquidate/seize.
External interest rate model used to accrue borrow interest.
Total outstanding borrows of the underlying, including accrued interest.
Total reserves of the underlying held by the market.
Total number of cTokens in circulation; exchange rate denominator.
Block number at which interest was last accrued; freshness check source.
Accumulated borrow interest index used to compute account borrow balances.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
Mapping of account cToken balances.
Mapping of account borrow snapshots (principal and interest index).
ERC-20 allowance mapping owner => spender => amount.
Exchange rate used when totalSupply is zero.
Fraction of interest set aside for reserves.
Price oracle used for collateral valuation and liquidation sizing.
Per-protocol credit limits bypassing collateral checks.
Maximum fraction of a borrow that may be repaid in one liquidation.
Liquidation bonus used to compute seize token amounts.
Mapping of cToken address to market metadata (listed flag, collateral factor, version, membership).
Per-market borrow caps enforced in borrowAllowed.
Per-market supply caps enforced in mintAllowed.
Collateral cap for collateral-cap cToken versions.
Per-market pause flag for flash loans.
Mapping of account to list of entered cToken markets iterated for liquidity.
ERC-20 balances of the Cream governance token.
Delegation mapping of the governance token.
Signature nonces used for replay protection in delegateBySig.
Initialises the market: sets comptroller, interest rate model, exchange rate and metadata (admin only).
ERC-20 transfer entrypoint delegating to transferTokens (nonReentrant).
ERC-20 transferFrom entrypoint delegating to transferTokens (nonReentrant).
Sets the allowance of a spender for msg.sender.
Accrues interest into totalBorrows/totalReserves and updates borrowIndex based on blocks elapsed.
Core borrow routine: comptroller check, then transfer out followed by storage writes.
Core repay routine: pulls tokens in via doTransferIn then reduces debt.
Core liquidation routine: repays borrow, computes seize amount and calls collateral cToken.
External seize entrypoint; uses msg.sender as seizer token (nonReentrant).
Internal seizure of collateral tokens for an in-kind liquidation.
Comptroller policy hook validating borrows, borrow caps and liquidity.
Comptroller policy hook validating mints and supply caps.
Internal redeem allowance check based on hypothetical liquidity.
Comptroller hook checking shortfall and close factor before liquidation.
Admin function to set the pending administrator.
Admin function for the pending admin to accept the role.
Admin function to set a new comptroller (validates marker method).
Admin function to set the reserve factor (requires fresh accrual).
Admin function to reduce reserves by transferring underlying to admin.
Adds reserves by pulling tokens from msg.sender.
Admin function to set a new interest rate model.
Computes hypothetical collateral/borrow values across all entered markets.
Computes cToken exchange rate from cash, borrows, reserves and total supply.
Computes a borrower's balance from principal and the global borrow index.
Admin function listing a new market.
Admin function removing a market from the comptroller.
Allows a cToken to update its own recorded version.
Internal cToken bookkeeping for transfers between accounts.
Internal mint logic executed after interest accrual.
Internal redeem logic executed after interest accrual.
Upgradeable proxy fallback performing delegatecall to comptrollerImplementation.
Governance delegation via ECDSA signature with nonce and expiry.
Internal governance token transfer updating balances and delegate votes.
Moves delegated votes between representatives.
Comptroller calculation of collateral tokens to seize from oracle prices.
External underlying/native transfer out of the market to an arbitrary address.
External underlying/native transfer in from an arbitrary payer address.
Cross-contract call to cTokenCollateral.seize() during liquidation.
External call to the comptroller to compute seize amounts.
External call to comptroller.borrowAllowed before funds are transferred.
delegatecall with attacker-supplied msg.data to the stored implementation address.
ecrecover used to derive the signatory of a delegation signature.
Unchecked-source additions building accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew.
Unchecked-source subtractions building accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew on repay.
Exchange rate division/multiplication over cash, borrows and reserves.
External oracle call returning the underlying price used for liquidity/liquidation.
External interest rate model call returning the per-block borrow rate.
Supply cap arithmetic combining totalCash, totalBorrows and totalReserves.

edges.reason: msg.sender must equal admin for initialize to succeed.
msg.sender must equal admin in _setPendingAdmin.
msg.sender must equal pendingAdmin in _acceptAdmin.
msg.sender must equal admin in _setComptroller.
msg.sender must equal admin in _setReserveFactorFresh.
msg.sender must equal admin in _reduceReservesFresh.
msg.sender must equal admin in _setInterestRateModelFresh.
only admin may support a market.
only admin may delist a market.
only the calling cToken (msg.sender) may update its version.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender.
borrowAllowed requires msg.sender == cToken when auto-adding the borrower to the market.
seize uses msg.sender as the seizing cToken rather than a caller-supplied parameter.
liquidator identity originates from msg.sender in the liquidation entrypoints.
reserves are pulled from msg.sender via doTransferIn.
block.timestamp must be <= expiry, a miner-influenced timestamp check.
totalBorrows read to compute the new total borrow balance.
totalBorrows updated with accrued interest in accrueInterest.
borrowIndex is written into the borrower's interest index.
borrowIndex is the accrual accumulator updated in accrueInterest.
totalReserves reduced and validated in _reduceReservesFresh.
totalReserves increased by the reserve share of accrued interest.
totalSupply is the denominator of the exchange rate.
borrower snapshot read from accountBorrows.
borrower principal and interest index rewritten on repayment.
the nonReentrant guard flag protects borrowFresh from re-entry.
the nonReentrant guard flag protects the liquidation path.
the nonReentrant guard flag protects seize.
initialExchangeRateMantissa returned when totalSupply is zero.
reserveFactorMantissa scales the interest routed to reserves.
account cToken balances are updated by transferTokens.
transferAllowances is written by approve.
oracle price is required to be non-zero before borrowing.
price value is obtained from the external oracle.
collateral and borrowed prices feed the seize token calculation.
creditLimits short-circuits or overrides the collateral computation.
closeFactorMantissa bounds the maximum repayment in a liquidation.
liquidationIncentiveMantissa scales the seized collateral amount.
market listed flag, version and borrower membership are read in borrowAllowed.
market version is mutated by updateCTokenVersion.
borrow cap comparison uses add_(totalBorrows, borrowAmount).
supply cap comparison uses addThenSubUInt/add_.
admin is the compared authority in _setPendingAdmin.
admin is the compared authority in _reduceReservesFresh.
pendingAdmin is compared and promoted to admin.
pendingAdmin is overwritten by _setPendingAdmin.
admin is overwritten by _acceptAdmin.
comptroller policy hooks are invoked from borrowFresh.
interest rate model is queried during accrual.
accountAssets list drives the per-asset liquidity loop.
governance token balances are debited/credited in _transferTokens.
delegates mapping read/written while moving votes.
nonce must match nonces[signatory] for the signature to be valid.
borrowFresh performs the external transfer out before writing borrow state (CEI violation).
a native/ERC-20 recipient can re-enter borrowFresh before totalBorrows and accountBorrows are updated.
repayBorrowFresh pulls tokens from the payer with an external call.
a malicious token transferFrom can re-enter repayBorrowFresh before balances are reduced.
liquidateBorrowFresh asks the comptroller how many tokens to seize.
liquidation performs an external seize call on the collateral cToken.
the external cTokenCollateral.seize() call can re-enter the liquidation flow before final state settlement.
borrowFresh consults comptroller.borrowAllowed before transferring funds.
external comptroller call during borrow can re-enter the caller before state writes.
the proxy fallback delegatecalls the stored implementation with raw calldata.
delegatecall executes implementation code in the proxy storage context.
delegateBySig recovers the signatory with ecrecover.
ecrecover returns a derived address that drives nonce and delegation effects.
accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew are computed with add_ during borrow.
accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew are computed with sub_ during repayment.
exchange rate is derived by dividing cash+borrows-reserves by totalSupply.
accrueInterest queries the external interest rate model for the borrow rate.
interest accumulates through mul_ScalarTruncate and add_ on borrows and index.
mintAllowed computes totalSupplies and nextTotalSupplies for the cap check.
per-asset oracle price is fetched inside the liquidity loop.
initialize calls _setComptroller.
initialize calls _setInterestRateModelFresh.
borrowFresh reads the borrower debt via borrowBalanceStoredInternal.
repayBorrowFresh reads the borrower debt via borrowBalanceStoredInternal.
liquidateBorrowFresh repays the borrower debt through repayBorrowFresh.
in-kind liquidation uses seizeInternal to avoid a self-call.
seize delegates to seizeInternal with msg.sender as the seizer.
borrowAllowed performs a hypothetical liquidity check.
redeemAllowedInternal performs a hypothetical liquidity check.
liquidateBorrowAllowed reads the account liquidity/shortfall.
transfer routes to transferTokens.
transferFrom routes to transferTokens.
delegateBySig ultimately performs delegation bookkeeping via transfer helpers.
_transferTokens moves delegate votes after updating balances.
comptroller_ parameter is stored and validated in initialize.
initialExchangeRateMantissa_ parameter is stored as the initial exchange rate.
newPendingAdmin parameter becomes the pending administrator.
newComptroller parameter is validated and stored.
newReserveFactorMantissa parameter is bounds-checked and stored.
reduceAmount parameter is subtracted from totalReserves.
addAmount parameter is added to totalReserves.
borrowAmount parameter drives debt and total borrow arithmetic and the transfer out.
repayAmount parameter (or uint256(-1)) determines the repayment size.
liquidator parameter receives the seized collateral.
borrower parameter identifies the debt being liquidated.
cTokenCollateral parameter is the external contract invoked via seize.
seizeTokens parameter is forwarded to seizeInternal.
dst parameter is the transfer recipient.
amount parameter is the number of tokens moved.
cToken parameter is the market being listed.
currentBlockNumber local is the block at which interest is accrued.
blockDelta local scales the borrow rate into interest.
simpleInterestFactor local multiplies rate by elapsed blocks.
interestAccumulated local is added to borrows and reserves.
BorrowLocalVars holds the new borrower and total borrow balances.
RepayBorrowLocalVars holds repayment amounts and new balances.
exchangeRateMantissa local is read from the collateral cToken for the seize ratio.
actualRepayAmount local reflects the amount actually pulled in by doTransferIn.
seizeTokens local is returned by the comptroller and used for the seize call.
totalSupplies/nextTotalSupplies locals implement the supply cap check.
shortfall local determines whether the borrow must be rejected.
nonce, expiry and digest locals drive signature validation.
accountBorrowsNew local is stored after the external transfer.
